committed_consumed_conditions.scope: Seeds derived from bound and discovered retained execution/assignment artifacts, independent of case labels. Invalid and unused assignments stay consumed. The registry is a checked index, not the sole source of condition identities.

joint_candidate_freeze: Both arms finish diagnosis and freeze candidates before either sees confirmation
limits: Case authoring and solver share development knowledge; no blinding or customer incident prevalence is claimed.
Calibration predictions are hypotheses; scored observations and the independent-of-selection evaluator decide outcomes.
An unsuccessful injection remains an assigned unsupported case; it is not replaced to improve the denominator.
Both arms receive the same final checker, repair space, available observations and budgets.
No adaptive arm is justified before A/B results expose a resolvable selection ambiguity.
